body:
Cold simulation readers currently seed gradients, extend building frontiers and rebuild blocked routes on the owner thread. This change requests complete immutable fields through the existing pipelines and publishes them at fixed logical deadlines. It covers building routes, natural/market and consumer-specific material fields, guard/clear areas, forbidden/escape guidance, and delayed air destination fields.

The owner controls deduplicated FIFO enrollment, deterministic admission and publication. Workers consume immutable primitive snapshots and produce private complete outputs through the existing ComputeExecutor. There is no second pool or synchronous overflow fallback. Readers distinguish Pending from a completed unavailable result; assigned units retain targets and reservations while waiting. Current local occupancy, restrictions and movement capability still determine whether a step is legal. Immediate air A* and hazardous-terrain escape routing remain owner work.

The implementation integrates master's completed-world observation boundary. Format 168 persists cold queues, complete unpublished outputs and remaining deadlines; supported full saves still start at 58. Replay acceptance advances to 168 and SIM_REVISION to 66, with regenerated golden records. Architecture and testing documentation describe ownership, request/publication boundaries and save migration.

Cold demand now waits for admission plus the configured delay (about 267 ms for eight ticks at 30 Hz). This changes feeding, recruitment, clearing and responses to freshly painted restrictions. Air destination selection also uses the common finite COST_LIMIT. A maintainer playtest should assess the resulting feel.

The 64 MiB air reservation accounts runtime-owned field outputs and logical retirement. Worker scratch, snapshots, pipeline spare buffers and arbitrarily retained external leases have separate lifetimes; this is not a total-process memory cap.

Independent subagent review found no remaining concrete production blocker. Review and testing fixed tick-zero publication metadata, queued/admitted text-save section collisions, finite supplier-penalty reachability, consumer supply-policy identity and retained private air-choice allocations. Regressions exercise those defects alongside FIFO pressure, hard supersession, soft invalidation, malformed saves, Pending consumers and immutable-field oracles.

Final verification on `f56cbc8f6`, integrated with `987c953`:

- macOS ARM64: 40 focused unit cases, 56 publication/save cases, 61 consumer cases, 108 owner-pipeline cases, 22 golden/focused cases, and 29 engine/network/replay/market/save-safety cases passed. One display-only panel case was skipped. Groups overlap; these are not distinct-case totals.
- Linux ARM64 / GCC 11.4: final native targets built; all 40 focused unit and 56 publication/save cases passed. All 38 publication traces match macOS byte for byte. Audits show zero covered owner kernel entries with workers.
- Both original eight-player Nicowar Playground saves (128x128, ticks 12000 and 24000) continued for 256 ticks at participants 1/2/4/8 on both platforms. All 16 runs agree on every corresponding per-tick world checksum. Source manifests also match.
- Normal golden verification, version/replay contracts, documentation navigation, private RNG ownership and browser-test syntax checks passed. Exact commands, binary hashes, saved checkpoints, replays and traces are in the [verification evidence](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/blob/481d4d001ee5221e5ce7163870bd92df7ab64d40/README.md); the [independent review](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/blob/481d4d001ee5221e5ce7163870bd92df7ab64d40/independent-review.md) describes the architecture and resolved findings.

No performance evaluation or speedup claim is included. Hosted platform checks are requested and may still be pending. Windows CI stops before compilation on a reproduced existing-master shader/CRLF receipt issue; the [checkout reproduction](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/blob/481d4d001ee5221e5ce7163870bd92df7ab64d40/windows-gradient-bundle/README.md) shows identical base inputs and preserves strict tamper rejection. Windows/x86, browser runtime, mobile and release runtime remain locally unverified. Initial runs interrupted by shared-disk exhaustion were excluded; complete passing reruns and the interruption logs are retained. The PR is prepared for review and has not been merged.
title: Publish complete simulation gradients at fixed deadlines
